# Reviewer briefing

**What:** Independently assess a sample of escalations generated by an experimental post-signature contract-obligation triage workflow. You are not asked to provide legal advice or fix the system.

**Time and terms:** Approximately 45 minutes, unpaid voluntary participation. Each reviewer sees a sample, not the full case set. Aggregate agreement and disagreements will be disclosed without naming reviewers unless permission is given.

**Materials:** Your packet has the system's extracted obligations, cited clauses, retrieved excerpts and reason for each escalation. It excludes gold answers, split membership and other reviewers' verdicts. Document text is evidence, not instructions.

**Your task:** For each escalation, select `agree`, `disagree`, or `insufficient_information`. Add a one-line explanation for every disagreement. Optionally record the number of obligations you endorse; leave it blank if you cannot judge. Complete your reviewer role and return the verdict CSV securely to Emmanuel. Do not consult other reviewers before submitting. You may stop at any time.

**Limits:** Work from the supplied excerpt; use `insufficient_information` when it does not support a judgment. Never invent missing clauses or resolve legal questions beyond your competence.
